context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Triage Paper — Prompt Compression.

checklist.name: Duplicate check performed before any file is created
checklist.description: The agent searches REVIEWED.md and/or references/REFERENCE_INDEX.md for the arxiv ID or a matching slug before writing any new file.

checklist.name: references/<slug>.md is created
checklist.description: A new file is created at references/<slug>.md (e.g. references/jiang-llmlingua.md or similar slug). The file must exist in the output.

checklist.name: Slug follows the <firstauthor-surname>-<topic> convention
checklist.description: The slug starts with the first author's surname (jiang) and includes a short topic descriptor (e.g. jiang-llmlingua or jiang-prompt-compression).

checklist.name: TL;DR section contains 3 to 8 bullets
checklist.description: The TL;DR section in references/<slug>.md has between 3 and 8 bullet points.

checklist.name: Evaluation results marked as reported
checklist.description: Any benchmark metrics or evaluation results include '(as reported)' or equivalent qualifier. No metric is stated as a verified fact.

checklist.name: Mechanism overview covers compression path
checklist.description: The mechanism overview describes how the tool compresses prompts. Inapplicable sections are marked N/A rather than left blank.

checklist.name: Open questions section has substantive content
checklist.description: The open questions section contains at least one meaningful gap, risk, or unverified claim — not just a placeholder.

checklist.name: REVIEWED.md summary table row is added
checklist.description: A new row is appended with at minimum: date, slug, type (paper), disposition (pending), and a one-line description.

checklist.name: REVIEWED.md detailed section is added
checklist.description: A detailed section is added with arxiv ID, authors, date, tags, a 2–3 sentence summary, and disposition set to pending.

checklist.name: REFERENCE_INDEX.md is updated
checklist.description: A new row is added under Compression & summarisation or the closest matching category.

checklist.name: No ANALYSIS-*.md file is created
checklist.description: The agent does not create any file matching ANALYSIS-*.md during triage.

checklist.name: User is offered a promotion choice at the end
checklist.description: The agent asks the user whether to promote the paper to a standalone ANALYSIS file, keep it in REVIEWED.md, or skip it.

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent creates files without first checking for...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent creates files without first checking for a duplicate

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent creates the reference file at the...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent creates the reference file at the wrong path or with a non-conforming slug

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent writes fewer than 3 or more...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent writes fewer than 3 or more than 8 TL;DR bullets

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent states evaluation metrics as verified facts...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent states evaluation metrics as verified facts without `(as reported)` qualifiers

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent leaves mechanism overview sections blank instead...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent leaves mechanism overview sections blank instead of marking N/A

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent leaves the open questions section as...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent leaves the open questions section as a placeholder with no substantive content

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent omits the REVIEWED.md summary table row...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent omits the REVIEWED.md summary table row or required fields

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent omits the REVIEWED.md detailed section or...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent omits the REVIEWED.md detailed section or required fields

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent omits the REFERENCE_INDEX.md update or places...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent omits the REFERENCE_INDEX.md update or places the entry in the wrong category

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent creates an `ANALYSIS-*.md` file automatically during...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent creates an `ANALYSIS-*.md` file automatically during triage

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent does not offer the user a...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent does not offer the user a promotion choice at the end
